text: For a startup, that can mean building without training a model from scratch.  A university can advance research.  A company can run AI on its own data.  A government can adapt it for a specific mission or language.   More builders means more competition, choice, and control.

text: Open and proprietary models both matter.   Frontier models will keep moving the boundary of what AI can do. Open models give more people the ability to build on that progress.   America’s AI leadership will depend on how broadly people can put AI to work.
